project_name: JEE & NEET AI Mock Test Platform (TestPrep AI)

theme.description: Tactical Academic Precision with high-contrast Obsidian slate backgrounds, energetic Cyber Indigo & Amber accent highlights for streak/paywall notifications, and clean NTA-simulator clarity.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400

rules: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for Main/Sub-headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk or Manrope.
Max hero font size is text-6xl. Do not exceed to 7xl or 8xl.
For formulas, question numbers, timers, and code snippets, use JetBrains Mono.

contrast_rules: Always set explicit text color on hover (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
Never use pure transparent backgrounds under headers or dropdown overlays. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/90 or solid bg-slate-900.
Forbidden colors: Do not use #7351B7 for main AI brand elements or #1B93A4 for dark dashboard backgrounds.

spacing_and_layout.system: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, gap-6, gap-8)

grid_modes.test_simulator: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 (Left Q-panel col-span-8/9, Right Palette col-span-4/3)

rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Grid children MUST be direct children. When animating with framer-motion, apply grid item classes directly to motion.div.

navigation_bar.style: Fixed top z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-800
features: Nav Links: Dashboard, Create Test, Analytics, Pricing, History
Free Questions Left Badge (e.g., '3/5 Free Left')
Live Countdown Timer with color states (Green >50%, Amber 20-50%, Red <20%)
NTA-Style Question Palette with status counters: Answered (Green), Not Answered (Red), Marked for Review (Purple), Not Visited (Gray)
Action Buttons: 'Save & Next', 'Clear Response', 'Mark for Review & Next', 'Submit Test'
Detailed Solution Accordion & ChatGPT Step-by-Step AI Explanation drawer upon submission

paywall_modal.trigger: Triggered when user attempts 6th question or creates 2nd test after consuming 5 free questions
paywall_modal.title: Unlock Unlimited JEE & NEET Mock Tests
highlights: JEE Main, JEE Advanced & NEET customized difficulty
Step-by-step instant solution explanations & weak area analytics

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: This codebase uses JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files. Do NOT use TypeScript syntax or create .tsx files.

ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, questions, palette buttons, Razorpay triggers) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='start-mock-test-button', data-testid='question-palette-item-1', data-testid='razorpay-pay-button').
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (Sonner component is at src/components/ui/sonner.js or sonner.jsx).
DO NOT add text-align: center to global .App class or main container.
DO NOT use generic AI emoji icons (🤖🧠💭💡) as main section icons. Use Lucide icons (lucide-react).
Ensure the first 5 questions free tracking is strictly reflected in UI state with a visible counter badge.
The ₹49 for 28 days plan paywall modal or Razorpay action section must be clearly accessible and highlighted with the amber/indigo CTA.
